changelog:
video-frames 1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Extract frames or short clips from videos using ffmpeg.
- Access 50+ models for image and video generation, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, music, chat, web search, document parsing, email, and SMS via a unified API (SkillBoss).
- Includes example API usage and parameter documentation for supported tasks.
